label: TikTok for Business (TikTok Ads Manager)
terms_note: Developer registration review ~3 business days, app review 2–3 business days; a scope change is another review (TikTok API for Business portal, verified 2026-09-23)

discovery.auth: oauth2 (developer app → advertiser authorization → long-lived Access-Token header)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (TikTok Marketing API / TikTok API for Business).
auth: 1. Create a TikTok For Business account. 2. Register as a developer. 3. Create a developer app (choose Marketing API scopes; app review).
4. Obtain authorization: the advertiser opens the app's authorization URL and approves → `auth_code` on the redirect.

5. Obtain authentication: exchange `auth_code` (`/open_api/v1.3/oauth2/access_token/` with app_id + secret) → long-lived `access_token` + `advertiser_ids`; send `Access-Token: <token>` header on every call.

endpoints.notes: advertiser_id, campaign_name, objective_type, budget, budget_mode BUDGET_MODE_DAY/TOTAL, operation_status

endpoints.purpose: ad groups: placements, targeting, budget, bid
endpoints.notes: adgroup_name, placement_type, location_ids, age_groups, budget, schedule_type, optimization_goal, bid_type, bid_price, billing_event
image_file / video_file (multipart) or url, image_id / video_id; creatives[]{ad_name, ad_text, call_to_action, landing_page_url, video_id, image_ids}
report_type BASIC, data_level AUCTION_CAMPAIGN…, dimensions[stat_time_day], metrics[spend, impressions, clicks, conversions], start_date, end_date
pixel_code / event_source_id, event, timestamp, context{user{email, phone hashed}}, properties{value, currency}

reference.limits: - Access requires app review; each advertiser must authorize the app. Rate limits per app / advertiser exist (TODO(verify) numbers). Free API; TikTok For Business Terms + Marketing API Terms.
mcp_sdk: Official: `tiktok/tiktok-business-api-sdk` — Java (Maven `tiktok-business-api-sdk-official`), Python (pip), JavaScript (npm). No official MCP server found.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Long-term advertiser access token from the TikTok API for Business authorization flow (/oauth2/access_token/), sent as the `Access-Token` header.

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: Developer app id (Application Management page); sent as a query parameter only to /oauth2/advertiser/get/ (me, list_accounts).

fields.name: secret
fields.help: The developer app's secret, sent as the `secret` query parameter only to /oauth2/advertiser/get/ (me, list_accounts).

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: Advertiser (ad account) id that update_budget writes to (campaign/update requires advertiser_id in the body).

me.note: GET /oauth2/advertiser/get/?app_id&secret returns {code, message, data: {list: [{advertiser_id, advertiser_name}]}}. TikTok answers HTTP 200 with a non-zero `code` on failure: check code == 0.

list_accounts.note: Advertiser accounts that authorised the app. Currency is not in this response (GET /advertiser/info/ has it). A non-zero `code` in a 200 body yields an empty list.

list_campaigns.note: GET /campaign/get/?advertiser_id&page&page_size (1-1000). `status` is operation_status ENABLE|DISABLE (secondary_status in raw); `budget` is in the account currency and its meaning follows budget_mode (BUDGET_MODE_DAY daily, BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL lifetime, BUDGET_MODE_INFINITE none). The `status` argument is not sent (filtering is a JSON object).

get_report.note: Synchronous basic report, campaign level, one row per campaign per day (YYYY-MM-DD, closed interval, ad account time zone); metrics are strings. `campaign_id` is not applied (the filter is a JSON array of objects); filter the rows instead. Up to 1,000 rows (page 1).

update_budget.note: POST /campaign/update/ {advertiser_id (config), campaign_id, budget}. The value replaces the campaign budget in its current budget_mode (daily only for BUDGET_MODE_DAY campaigns), in the account currency; `currency` is ignored. A failed update (non-zero code, empty data) is reported as invalid_input.

pause_resume.note: POST /campaign/status/update/ {advertiser_id (config), campaign_ids: [campaign_id], operation_status: DISABLE (pause) | ENABLE (resume)}; answers {code, data: {status, campaign_ids}}. Deleted campaigns cannot change status. A non-zero code (empty data) is reported as invalid_input.

evidence: host business-api.tiktok.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 308 (redirect), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/6 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: pause_resume:advertiser_id, pause_resume:campaign_ids, pause_resume:operation_status
auth_audit.notes: Fixed: TikTok Business API answers HTTP 200 {code: 40105, message} for errors; without an envelope the tools returned empty successes. Envelope code=0 added.
